items.title: edie 27: Full programme revealed for flagship sustainable business event
items.summary: edie 27 is returning to London next April to drive adaptation, resilience and practical sustainable business transformation.

items.title: ESG台灣快訊》碳費調漲卡關？環團呼籲升至1200元｜50家企業出資1.14億元護生態
items.summary: 11月2日召開 費率審議委員會，針對「維持現行費率」、「僅調漲一般費率」及「一般與優惠費率同步調漲」三項方案進行討論，但未達成共識。目前一般費率為每噸300元，優惠費率則為50元及100元，今年首筆碳費收入約49.7億元。

items.title: 封面故事／經濟高成長減碳不打折　彭啓明：碳費抓大放小給傳產喘息空間
items.summary: 受惠於AI與半導體產業大爆發，台灣連續二年經濟高成長，風光的背後也代表著排碳壓力巨大，加上氣候變遷帶來的多次天災，身為環境守門人的環境部長彭啓明，肩負任務跟著加重。日前他接受本刊專訪，引用賴清德總統國慶致詞的《聖經》金句，強調「守護環境，就跟鹽一樣！

items.title: ESG Today: Week in Review
items.summary: This week in ESG news: UK to introduce supply chain human rights due diligence law; EU Commission scraps Green Claims Directive; Green Climate Fund approves record $3.3 billion climate investments; Brazil considers moving back to mandatory corporate sustainability reporting; Deloitte launches new solution to help companies avoid greenwashing; UK regulates ESG ratings providers; Thailand introduces mandatory ISSB-aligned sustainability reporting requirements; BCG appoints new head of Climate & Sustainability practice; Outrigger Impact launches $100 million blue economy fund, and more.
